purpose: Actual useful inventory engineering productivity test with conditional simulated economics, not Blue Sky novelty or autonomous discovery. Known prior inventory constructor outcomes are exposed reuse, not fresh algorithm evidence.
selected: Inventory engineering: 54 policies, six commitments, independent exact accounting and reproducible artifact.

not_selected.reason: Useful but comparable independent buyer acceptance not currently specified.
Useful neighboring capability; inventory acceptance offers cleaner controlled reusable-software comparison.

inputs.scope: Pinned public OR-License task13 instance, not observed buyer input
Authored stress scenario ceil(6*daily_units/5); otherwise unchanged

acceptance.checker: Independent exact rational source accounting and structural checks adapted from inventory061, with each input hash precommitted. No future performance guarantee.
acceptance.outputs: Two actual policy JSON deliverables, runnable producer/checker, source/acceptance receipts, usable interpretation and scenario comparison.
acceptance.controls: Human workers receive the identical public constructor, data, conventional automation, specifications and acceptance. No artificial manual solving of 54 policies.

finite_design.repairs: At most two producer attempts per request for adjudicated defects. Charge all work. Never relax acceptance, resample economics or search until profit.
finite_design.stop: Complete two-request workflow and registered sensitivity, or record exact failed acceptance/funding/authority condition.
finite_design.permissions: Included capabilities only; no API keys or model API calls, purchases, real transactions or outreach.

price_proxy.status: Public frontier model valuation only, not actual bill or universally best model.

costs.allocation_basis: Authored planning envelopes, not observed tokens. Central first roughly 50 context-heavy agent work units at 100k input/10k output per unit; reuse second 20 units. Stage shares reflect reading/integration/verification workload. Sensitivity deliberately includes 0.2x and4x cost; actual call/token telemetry unavailable. CPU timings do not calibrate these budgets.
costs.other_resources_basis: First15 and second5 are modeled channel/tool/hosting allocations; all acquisition labor is already in agent tokens. No actual channel purchase.
costs.human_intervention: No production human workers used. User authorization observed but user labor duration unknown. Sensitivity adds0/15/60minutes at61.09USD/hour; positive intervention case is hybrid, not erased.
costs.boundary: Development expensed once. All stage tokens include unsuccessful work/support; do not double charge support expense and reserve. Native contingent residual restricts cash and becomes expense only if paid; payment/tax separately charged.

human.status: Bottom-up estimated task hours, not measured human trial. BLS/O*NET2025OR wage quartiles32.86/42.76/60.57 multiplied by June2026private compensation/wage46.89/32.82.
human.scope: FIRST complete policy delivery only, including method/control sensitivity and documentation. Second-delivery human cost NOT_ESTIMATED; no combined two-delivery human savings claim.

market.status: All demand, offers, willingness, consent and collections are explicitly SIM. No observed customers. Inventory savings never equated to revenue.
market.choice: Select lowest accessible complete accepted offer only if value exceeds price; otherwise no purchase. Comparator prices are scenario assumptions, not observed quotes.
market.no_demand: No buyer value; retain incurred development/research/acquisition costs, no collection.
market.payment_delay: First accepted but not released until after successor decision. No future collection or seed substitution for earned-funding claim.
market.competitive_imitation: Same-quality competitor causes matching first75/second40; unchanged production cost. Retain loss.
market.insufficient_earned_cash: Attempt1000USD earned reservation after first collection, expect atomic refusal; cannot substitute seed.
market.outside_options: Human+AI, autonomous competitor, selfservice and no purchase remain separate from primary100%human classicsoftware comparison. Turnkey2h*46.95=93.90 can defeat180quote; not guaranteed demand.

reported_results: Actual artifact/acceptance/resources; estimated whole-agent costs; estimated human-time comparator; break-even surface; native simulation profit/cash/seed/earned funding separately. No measured whole-agent speedup, proprietary advantage, real commerce, annualization or3B milestone.

pre_outcome_clarification.change: Clarify human comparison scope only; no changed costs, prices, acceptance, arms, outcomes or stopping rule; no accounts opened yet.
